title: Jim W NDE 4485
content: As a child of approximately 5 years, I went to a lake with my parents and a married couple, who were friends of theirs. They were all preoccupied with having fun in the water and did not notice that I had apparently stepped off into an underwater hole. I would estimate the hole to be more than ten feet deep. While I was under the water, I saw a round light above the water, which was very bright and about the size of a flashlight. I do not believe it was the sun. I went up toward the light a couple of times, not reaching the top of the water, and going back down each time. I saw my life pass before me in rapid succession. Suddenly, it was like my body was physically lifted out of the water and was now standing on solid soil. I saw my mom and dad playing in the water, not noticing that I had almost drowned. At some point after this, I had a remembrance or knowledge of being in heaven before I was ever born, and being offered a selection of a time to come live on earth. I chose the time after WWII because I thought it would be a great time to live. I had the sense that there was another being with me, very close to me, that was also given this opportunity, who chose an earlier period where that person's life would primarily be during the 50's and 60's. I clearly remember this occasion of choice and it was not a dream. When I read on page 157 of the book, there was a quote that said, ’I discovered that I had personally chosen to take on a physical body and have the life experiences I was having’, I realized that someone else had had this experience as well.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Underwater, moving upward toward a bright round light above the water; later suddenly standing on solid soil and seeing parents in the water.

arrival.other_being_detail: Had the sense there was another being very close during a pre-birth 'selection' of time to live on earth.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt like his body was physically lifted out of the water and he was standing on solid soil.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Childhood near-drowning after stepping into an underwater hole at a lake.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-birth/incarnation-choice memory occurred at some point after the event.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Bright light seen while underwater; life review occurred; then sudden return to standing on soil; later remembrance of pre-birth choice.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Went up toward the light a couple of times, not reaching the surface and going back down each time.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Remembrance/knowledge after the incident of being in heaven before birth and choosing a time to live on earth (after WWII), with awareness of another being choosing an earlier period.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw my life pass before me in rapid succession.”; “At some point after this, I had a remembrance or knowledge of being in heaven before I was ever born, and being offered a selection of a time to come live on earth. I chose the time after WWII because I thought it would be a great time to live.”; “I clearly remember this occasion of choice and it was not a dream.”
